en.intro: This 16 in (40.6 cm) black cauldron adds a witchy centerpiece to a Halloween party, porch or entryway, and it holds candy for trick-or-treaters. FeelBetter orders it from the overseas seller after you check out and ships it to you in Korea.
highlights: A classic black witch cauldron look that suits both indoor and outdoor Halloween setups.
Holds candies, chocolates and other treats, so it works as a trick-or-treat container.
Works as a centerpiece, or fill it with glow sticks for an added spooky glow.
Durable, lightweight blow-mold plastic is easy to move around and to store between seasons.
Measures 16 in long, 16 in wide and 12 in tall (about 40.6 x 40.6 x 30.5 cm).

sections.p: Place it on a table, porch or hallway as a centerpiece, or pair it with other witchy decorations for a themed corner. Fill it with candy for guests and trick-or-treaters, or add glow sticks after dark.
At 16 x 16 x 12 in (40.6 x 40.6 x 30.5 cm) it is a generous size, so measure your spot first. The lightweight plastic is easy to carry and put away after Halloween.

Measure your display space first, as the cauldron is 16 x 16 x 12 in (40.6 x 40.6 x 30.5 cm).

Mida antes el espacio, ya que el caldero mide 40,6 x 40,6 x 30,5 cm.
